description: This file defines the DataGroupDao class, which provides data access methods for managing DataGroup and DataGroupPermission entities within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for retrieving data groups, permissions, and API permissions, as well as filtering permissions based on various criteria.

classes.name: DataGroupDao
classes.description: DataGroupDao class extends BaseDao and provides methods to query DataGroup and DataGroupPermission entities for authorization purposes within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getDataGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a DataGroup entity by its name.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Fetches permissions for specified data groups, user role ID, and self-permission flag.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves API permissions associated with a given API class name and roles.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions based on filter parameters encapsulated in DataGroupPermissionFilterParams.

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Fetches all DataGroup entities ordered by description.
